lessons: In ProcessExec.run, when a consumer error is pending and the unwind is asyncio.CancelledError or TimeoutError, re-raise the original exception, not the consumer error. Ticket Scope out and Definition of rejected forbid changing timeout or group-kill behavior.

Raise the stored consumer exception, with stdout/stderr capture attached, only after a normal drain to EOF and child reap. That is the ticket's Scope-in path; every other unwind must keep its original exception type.

Leave test_event_callback_unwind_kills_group[callback_cancel] and [callback_timeout] expecting CancelledError/TimeoutError. If an edit makes either case expect RuntimeError, the edit is pinning a forbidden behavior change.

The merged driver._kill and abort() run race.call.cancel() and then cleanup(), ignoring only CancelledError/LLMAborted. Keep that path raising CancelledError so a deliberate stage kill is not reported as a cleanup failure.

Keep the parts that passed review: drain to EOF, reap the child, and have CliAdapter.invoke write the scrubbed events.jsonl and stderr.txt before propagating. Keep the regression test failing on the merge base.
